text:
lisa: Hey team — ACME (acct: acme-inc) flagged a subtle change in response verbosity/voice after we rolled redwood-v5.2 to hosted last night. They say replies are shorter, fewer examples, and sometimes omit the final polite sign-off. Not a hard failure but customer impact on UX.

support-bot: Ticket created: #SD-4921 for ACME — assigned to support queue. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks Lisa. Can you paste the customer's minimal repro prompt + the two responses (before = v5.1, after = v5.2)? If they included exact API params that'd help.

lisa: They sent a short example. Copied below (redacted customer data).

```
PROMPT:
System: You are a helpful product documentation assistant.
User: "Summarize how to export billing reports and include 2 examples of export filters." 
API params: model=redwood-v5.2, temperature=0.2, top_p=0.9, max_tokens=180
```

lisa: Customer pasted the two outputs — i added inline labels.

```
BEFORE (v5.1):
- Brief intro sentence.
- Step 1: Navigate to Billing > Exports.
- Step 2: Select date range.
- Example 1: Filter by project ID to export per-project spend (shows sample CSV header).
- Example 2: Filter by invoice status to get unpaid invoices.

Best, and let me know if you want the CSV sample.

AFTER (v5.2):
- Steps to export billing reports.
- Example filters: project ID, invoice status.
```

lisa: Customer says v5.2 removed the explicit CSV example and the closing sentence. They tested 10 requests and saw average token count drop ~14 tokens per response.

raj: Good concrete repro, thanks. A few quick asks: did they pin system prompt at the SDK layer or pass a different system message? Also, are they using `response_format` or function-calling? small changes there can affect verbosity.

lisa: They keep the same system text. No function-calling. Confirmed via customer logs: model field changed to redwood-v5.2 at ~1765119000.

sam: Can we reproduce locally with the exact API params? If so, create a short script and run v5.1 vs v5.2 and attach raw tokens. Example command: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v5.2","input":"<PROMPT>","temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.9,"max_tokens":180}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY'
```

chris: From infra side — nothing unusual in latency or truncation thresholds on the pool. Also check if `max_new_tokens` or `max_tokens` client-side truncation changed.

raj: If we reproduce, check sampling-related defaults: we recently tightened nucleus sampling fallback behavior for certain architectures. That can reduce tail-verbosity. I'll pull the kernel/runtime changes between v5.1 -> v5.2 to see if any default logits temperature scheduling changed.

elen: Customer revenue impact? ACME says internal QA noticed degraded user satisfaction for end users of the docs assistant. They've paused rollout on their side until we confirm. Mark high-touch.

sam: Action items: 1) Sam/lisa to run repro script against v5.1 and v5.2 and capture raw JSON + token counts (by EOD). 2) Raj to diff model serving defaults and any post-processing heuristics that could truncate polite closers or examples. 3) Chris to verify there wasn't an inline post-processing filter applied at the infra edge. 4) Elena will prepare an update for ACME and offer temporary pin to v5.1.

support-bot: Reminder — please post findings in this thread and upload repro artifacts to SD-4921.

lisa: I'll run the script now and paste results here when done.

sam: Thanks — if anyone finds a quick mitigation (e.g., bump temperature to 0.4 or append an explicit "Include 2 examples and a closing sentence" to system prompt) call it out in-thread so we can give the customer a workaround. :thinking_face:
